sentences.en: We get support from UC Davis, a globally ranked university working to solve the world's most pressing problems in food, energy, health, education, and the environment.
sentences.zh: 我们得到了加州大学戴维斯分校的支持，这是一所全球排名前列的大学，致力于解决世界在食品、能源、健康、教育和环境方面最紧迫的问题。

sentences.en: UC Davis researchers collaborate and innovate in California and around the globe to find transformational solutions.
sentences.zh: 加州大学戴维斯分校的研究人员在加州乃至全球范围内开展合作与创新，以寻找变革性的解决方案。

sentences.en: It's all part of the university's mission to promote quality of life for all living things.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是该大学促进所有生物生活质量这一使命的一部分。

sentences.en: Find out more at 21stCentury.UCDavis.edu.
sentences.zh: 欲了解更多信息，请访问 21stCentury.UCDavis.edu。

sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%隐形》。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: In 1998, Dr. Gary Kaplan, the CEO of Virginia Mason Medical Center in Seattle, received some bad news about his hospital.
sentences.zh: 1998年，西雅图弗吉尼亚梅森医疗中心的首席执行官加里·卡普兰医生收到了一些关于他医院的坏消息。

sentences.en: It was losing money.
sentences.zh: 医院正在亏损。

sentences.en: That voice is David Weinberg, who's doing our reporting for us today.
sentences.zh: 刚才那个声音是戴维·温伯格，他今天为我们进行报道。

sentences.en: So, back to the story.
sentences.zh: 那么，回到故事本身。

sentences.en: To STEM losses at Virginia Mason, Dr. Kaplan starts studying how other hospitals are managed.
sentences.zh: 为了遏制弗吉尼亚梅森的亏损，卡普兰医生开始研究其他医院的管理方式。

sentences.en: So he started scouring the country, looking for a hospital with a management system worth adopting.
sentences.zh: 于是他开始在全国范围内搜寻，寻找一套值得借鉴的管理系统。

sentences.en: And if you're anything like me, when you hear the phrase, management system,
sentences.zh: 如果你和我一样，当你听到“管理系统”这个词时，

sentences.en: part of your brain begins to shut down and another part of your brain prepares itself for hearing a lot of either complete nonsense or common sense tarted up with unnecessary jargon.
sentences.zh: 你大脑的一部分就开始关闭，而另一部分则准备好去听一大堆废话，或者是一些用不必要的术语包装起来的常识。

sentences.en: But really, all you need to understand here is that Dr. Kaplan was looking for a hospital that had processes and procedures that were better than what he was already using.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，你在这里只需要明白，卡普兰医生是在寻找一家拥有比他现有流程和程序更好的医院。

sentences.en: But he never found one.
sentences.zh: 但他一直没找到。

sentences.en: So instead, he ended up in Japan.
sentences.zh: 所以最后，他去了日本。

sentences.en: At a Toyota factory.
sentences.zh: 去了一家丰田工厂。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The automobile company.
sentences.zh: 就是那家汽车公司。

sentences.en: And think about that.
sentences.zh: 想想看。

sentences.en: This is a very smart physician who goes around the country looking for a great management system and doesn't find one.
sentences.zh: 这是一位非常聪明的医生，他跑遍全国寻找一套出色的管理系统，却一无所获。

sentences.en: Charles Kinney is the author of Transforming Healthcare, a book about Virginia Mason's journey to adapt the Toyota production system to healthcare.
sentences.zh: 查尔斯·金尼是《医疗转型》一书的作者，该书讲述了弗吉尼亚梅森将丰田生产系统引入医疗领域的历程。

sentences.en: He says that when Dr. Kaplan told his staff they would be changing everything about the way they operate, and the changes were based on a car company,
sentences.zh: 他说，当卡普兰医生告诉员工他们将改变所有运营方式，而且这些改变是基于一家汽车公司时，

sentences.en: and that the doctors and nurses should refer to their new teachers as sensei, the response was not pretty.
sentences.zh: 并且医生和护士应该称呼他们的新老师为“先生”（sensei），反应并不好。

sentences.en: There was a lot of anger from people within his organization, led by the doctors, of course.
sentences.zh: 组织内部的人对此感到非常愤怒，当然，带头的是医生们。

sentences.en: And this whole multi-year overhaul started with a ball of blue yarn.
sentences.zh: 而这场历时多年的全面改革，始于一团蓝色的毛线。

sentences.en: The staff met with a sensei, and he took out the ball of blue yarn and a map of the hospital,
sentences.zh: 员工们与一位“先生”会面，他拿出一团蓝色的毛线和一张医院地图，

sentences.en: and he told the staff to trace the path a cancer patient would take on a typical visit for chemotherapy treatment.
sentences.zh: 他让员工们描绘出一位癌症患者在进行化疗的典型就诊过程中所走的路径。

sentences.en: And then the yarn went across a couple inches, and then it maybe went up approximately five inches to where they'd have to get their blood drawn.
sentences.zh: 毛线在纸上延伸了几英寸，然后可能向上延伸了大约五英寸，那是他们必须去抽血的地方。

sentences.en: And then they would go up to the 14th floor, and on the cardboard, that was like maybe four inches above that.
sentences.zh: 然后他们得去14楼，在纸板上，那大概是在上面四英寸的地方。

sentences.en: Michelle Wetland is a nurse manager at Virginia Mason.
sentences.zh: 米歇尔·韦特兰是弗吉尼亚梅森的一名护士长。

sentences.en: And then they'd have to come and see their doctor, which was in a different location.
sentences.zh: 然后他们还得去见医生，而医生在另一个地方。

sentences.en: And it was so big on our board that we just had to keep winding it around itself.
sentences.zh: 它在我们的板子上占地面积太大了，我们不得不一直把它缠绕起来。

sentences.en: And that's Dr. Henry Otero.
sentences.zh: 那是亨利·奥特罗医生。

sentences.en: Creating kind of this circular maze, like you would wind a yo-yo.
sentences.zh: 就像绕溜溜球一样，形成了一种圆形的迷宫。

sentences.en: And when we looked at it, we were amazed at how far our patients traveled.
sentences.zh: 当我们看着它时，我们对患者所走的距离感到震惊。

sentences.en: We were asking oncology patients who are, their oxygen-carrying capacity is compromised because the chemotherapy destroys a lot of red blood cells,
sentences.zh: 我们要求那些肿瘤科患者——他们的携氧能力因为化疗破坏了大量红细胞而受损，

sentences.en: so that makes them short of breath.
sentences.zh: 这让他们感到气短。

sentences.en: And here we're asking patients to do this who were short of breath to begin with.
sentences.zh: 而我们却要求这些本来就气短的患者去走这段路。

sentences.en: So it was just, it was appalling to us.
sentences.zh: 所以这简直……这让我们感到震惊。

sentences.en: And I think it was that mapping of the flows of medicine and the patient understanding,
sentences.zh: 我认为正是那种对医疗流程和患者理解的绘图，

sentences.en: the patient's journey was that eye-opening moment that you realize you don't really know what's going on.
sentences.zh: 那种患者的旅程，是一个让人大开眼界的时刻，让你意识到你根本不知道发生了什么。

sentences.en: The Blue Yarn told the story of what Virginia Mason was doing wrong.
sentences.zh: 蓝色的毛线讲述了弗吉尼亚梅森做错的事情。

sentences.en: We just didn't, we couldn't conceive of it intellectually until we saw it visually.
sentences.zh: 我们只是……在视觉化看到之前，我们无法从理智上构想出它。

sentences.en: And the story it told was not a good one to Dr. Otero.
sentences.zh: 而它所讲述的故事对奥特罗医生来说并不好。

sentences.en: He thought he was providing exceptional care for his patients.
sentences.zh: 他以为自己为患者提供了卓越的护理。

sentences.en: They basically came into my exam room and they left.
sentences.zh: 他们基本上走进我的检查室，然后离开。

sentences.en: And I really said, I'm a great doctor.
sentences.zh: 我真的说，我是一位伟大的医生。

sentences.en: Look at this great care I give.
sentences.zh: 看看我提供的这些伟大的护理。

sentences.en: I see them.
sentences.zh: 我看了他们。

sentences.en: I send them out.
sentences.zh: 我送他们走。

sentences.en: And, you know, they just must feel like they have this great experience of having care here.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，他们一定觉得在这里接受护理的体验很棒。

sentences.en: Then he saw the twisting path of the Blue Yarn.
sentences.zh: 然后他看到了那条扭曲的蓝色毛线路径。

sentences.en: Oh, how awful it is for them.
sentences.zh: 噢，这对他们来说太糟糕了。

sentences.en: How awful it must be to really wait everywhere along the way.
sentences.zh: 一路上到处都要等待，那一定很糟糕。

sentences.en: And that I was contributing to that and that it became an intolerance really to, I couldn't accept it anymore.
sentences.zh: 而我竟然是其中的推手，这让我无法忍受，我再也无法接受了。

sentences.en: Six months after that first meeting, Dr. Mecklenburg, the hospital's chief of medicine, led a group of staff on a three-week trip to Japan to meet with a different sensei.
sentences.zh: 在那次会议六个月后，医院内科主任梅克伦堡医生带领一组员工前往日本进行了为期三周的访问，去见另一位“先生”。

sentences.en: And so they pulled out the schematic, essentially an architect's drawing of various parts of the Virginia Mason Medical Center.
sentences.zh: 他们拿出了示意图，本质上是弗吉尼亚梅森医疗中心各个部分的建筑图纸。

sentences.en: And the sensei kept pointing to these areas and saying, what is that?
sentences.zh: 那位“先生”不停地指着这些区域问：“那是什么？”

sentences.en: And Dr. Mecklenburg would say, well, that's a waiting area.
sentences.zh: 梅克伦堡医生会说：“哦，那是候诊区。”

sentences.en: And this happened over and over again.
sentences.zh: 这种情况反复发生。

sentences.en: Well, that's a waiting area.
sentences.zh: “哦，那是候诊区。”

sentences.en: And as this was happening, the sensei seems to him to be getting increasingly angry.
sentences.zh: 随着这一切的发生，那位“先生”在他看来似乎越来越生气。

sentences.en: And he says to Mecklenburg, why are there so many waiting areas throughout this facility?
sentences.zh: 他问梅克伦堡：“为什么这个设施里有这么多候诊区？”

sentences.en: Who's waiting there?
sentences.zh: 谁在那里等待？

sentences.en: What are they doing?
sentences.zh: 他们在做什么？

sentences.en: What are they waiting for?
sentences.zh: 他们在等什么？

sentences.en: And Dr. Mecklenburg says, those are our patients.
sentences.zh: 梅克伦堡医生说：“那是我们的患者。”

sentences.en: They're waiting for us.
sentences.zh: 他们在等我们。

sentences.en: And the sensei, long pause, looks quite furious, looks directly at Dr. Mecklenburg, and in front of Mecklenburg's team says to him, aren't you ashamed?
sentences.zh: 那位“先生”沉默了很久，看起来非常愤怒，直视着梅克伦堡医生，在梅克伦堡的团队面前对他说：“你不感到羞愧吗？”

sentences.en: And Dr. Mecklenburg said at that moment he was ashamed.
sentences.zh: 梅克伦堡医生说那一刻他感到羞愧。

sentences.en: He was absolutely ashamed.
sentences.zh: 他感到无比羞愧。

sentences.en: If I told you to picture a waiting room, you were probably picturing a doctor's office.
sentences.zh: 如果我让你想象一个候诊室，你可能想象的是医生的办公室。

sentences.en: This is what we are trained to do when we go to the doctor.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们去看医生时受到的训练。

sentences.en: We are trained to wait.
sentences.zh: 我们受到的训练就是等待。

sentences.en: But to a sensei who's been trained in the Toyota production system, waiting is a form of waste.
sentences.zh: 但对于一位受过丰田生产系统训练的“先生”来说，等待是一种浪费。

sentences.en: And the number one tenet of the TPS is to eliminate waste.
sentences.zh: 而丰田生产系统的第一准则就是消除浪费。

sentences.en: The staff completely redesigned the cancer center, and they hired an architect who had first-hand knowledge of cancer treatment as a patient.
sentences.zh: 员工们彻底重新设计了癌症中心，他们聘请了一位曾作为患者亲身体验过癌症治疗的建筑师。

sentences.en: He designed the journey differently to really be patient firSt.
sentences.zh: 他以不同的方式设计了整个流程，真正做到了以患者为先。

sentences.en: The new design put patients on the outer edges of the building, in these rooms with big windows that let in natural light and provided views of the Puget Sound.
sentences.zh: 新设计将患者安置在建筑的外缘，在这些有大窗户的房间里，自然光射入，还能看到普吉特海湾的景色。

sentences.en: But in order to give the patients these rooms, they had to take them away from the doctors who had their offices there.
sentences.zh: 但为了给患者提供这些房间，他们不得不把这些空间从原本在那里办公的医生手中拿走。

sentences.en: It wasn't something that really was difficult for me because I think we were always in the right direction with the patient.
sentences.zh: 对我来说这并不困难，因为我认为我们始终朝着对患者正确的方向前进。

sentences.en: I think for others who maybe didn't go through that process, they saw it as a takeaway.
sentences.zh: 我认为对于那些可能没有经历过这个过程的人来说，他们把它看作是一种剥夺。

sentences.en: You know, I had the great office, the great window.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我以前有很棒的办公室，很棒的窗户。

sentences.en: Now you're putting me in this cubicle, you know, and I'm the guy who does all the work, you know.
sentences.zh: 现在你把我放进这个隔间里，你知道，而我才是那个干活的人，你知道。

sentences.en: So, you know, shouldn't I have the big office?
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，难道我不应该有大办公室吗？

sentences.en: Some doctors were so angry they quit.
sentences.zh: 有些医生非常生气，以至于辞职了。

sentences.en: But Dr. Otero says that everyone who stayed realizes it was the right thing to do for the patients.
sentences.zh: 但奥特罗医生说，所有留下来的人都意识到这对患者来说是正确的事情。

sentences.en: When I go there and I see them there and I see them looking out, and I recognize that's a much better place than being.
sentences.zh: 当我走到那里，看到他们坐在那里，看到他们向外望去，我意识到那比待在原来的地方要好得多。

sentences.en: I'm gratified that that decision was made, and it totally was the right decision.
sentences.zh: 我为做出了那个决定感到欣慰，这绝对是正确的决定。

sentences.en: There's not even a question about it.
sentences.zh: 这一点毫无疑问。

sentences.en: Relocating patients was just the beginning.
sentences.zh: 重新安置患者仅仅是个开始。

sentences.en: Today, the new cancer center has been dubbed the Cancer Spa.
sentences.zh: 今天，新的癌症中心被称为“癌症水疗中心”。

sentences.en: It was designed to create an environment of healing.
sentences.zh: 它的设计旨在创造一个治愈的环境。

sentences.en: So it has, it's a real pretty pale yellow color.
sentences.zh: 所以它有一种非常漂亮的淡黄色。

sentences.en: We use colors of nature, so yellow for sunshine, and we have browns to simulate and greens to simulate nature.
sentences.zh: 我们使用自然的颜色，黄色代表阳光，我们有棕色和绿色来模拟自然。

sentences.en: And we have a water wall.
sentences.zh: 我们还有一面水墙。

sentences.en: There's two of them actually.
sentences.zh: 实际上有两面。

sentences.en: And just so you don't think that this new management system resulted only in natural colored walls and big windows,
sentences.zh: 为了不让你认为这个新的管理系统仅仅带来了自然色的墙壁和大窗户，

sentences.en: the whole reason why this blue yarn was unspooled to begin with was to save the hospital money.
sentences.zh: 当初解开这团蓝色毛线的全部原因是为了给医院省钱。

sentences.en: And it did.
sentences.zh: 而且确实做到了。

sentences.en: And it also made it a safer place.
sentences.zh: 它也让这里变得更安全。

sentences.en: From 2007 to 2009, Virginia Mason was so much safer that their insurance expenses declined by an astonishing 37%.
sentences.zh: 从2007年到2009年，弗吉尼亚梅森变得如此安全，以至于他们的保险费用惊人地下降了37%。

sentences.en: While simultaneously increasing the number of patients they treated, all without having to hire any additional staff.
sentences.zh: 同时，他们治疗的患者数量增加了，而且无需雇佣任何额外员工。

sentences.en: And yet some people still scoff at the idea of Toyota-inspired management.
sentences.zh: 然而，有些人仍然对丰田启发的管理理念嗤之以鼻。

sentences.en: I was on a boat once, and someone said to me, so are you guys still building Toyotas in your basement?
sentences.zh: 我曾经在船上，有人对我说：“那么，你们还在地下室造丰田车吗？”

sentences.en: And that was, that was a real, I mean, I was offended because I knew that what we're doing here is really good.
sentences.zh: 那真是……我的意思是，我被冒犯了，因为我知道我们在这里所做的事情真的很好。

sentences.en: And I said to him, you know, you can say what you want to make fun of what we're doing, but we're trying to do the best by the patient.
sentences.zh: 我对他说：“你知道，你可以说任何你想说的话来嘲笑我们所做的事情，但我们是在尽力为患者着想。”

sentences.en: This complete upheaval of the medical industry, which stemmed from a single thread of blue yarn,
sentences.zh: 这场源于一根蓝色毛线的医疗行业彻底变革，

sentences.en: became especially poignant when the staff visited Japan for the first time and saw an exhibit at the Toyota History Museum.
sentences.zh: 当员工们第一次访问日本并参观丰田历史博物馆的展览时，显得尤为深刻。

sentences.en: It was an automatic loom.
sentences.zh: 那是一台自动织布机。

sentences.en: That was where the team learned that the Toyota production system was in fact born quite literally from a single thread of yarn.
sentences.zh: 团队就是在那里了解到，丰田生产系统实际上确实诞生于一根纱线。

sentences.en: Might have even been blue.
sentences.zh: 甚至可能就是蓝色的。

sentences.en: Toyota was originally a textile manufacturer, and in 1902, Sakichi Toyota invented a self-correcting loom
sentences.zh: 丰田最初是一家纺织制造商，1902年，丰田佐吉发明了一种自动纠错织布机，

sentences.en: that would stop when a thread was broken or woven incorrectly.
sentences.zh: 当线断了或编织错误时，它会自动停止。

sentences.en: The museum is a story of continuous process improvement.
sentences.zh: 博物馆讲述的是一个持续改进流程的故事。

sentences.en: You start with back-breaking work on a manual loom that is producing defective product,
sentences.zh: 你从手动织布机上繁重的工作开始，生产出有缺陷的产品，

sentences.en: and you put in the first components of ergonomics, putting the person sitting up,
sentences.zh: 然后你引入了人体工程学的首要组件，让人坐着工作，

sentences.en: instead of sitting on the floor.
sentences.zh: 而不是坐在地板上。

sentences.en: Then you start making automatic looms and improve the machinery.
sentences.zh: 然后你开始制造自动织布机并改进机械。

sentences.en: Then you start developing mistake-proofing into the process,
sentences.zh: 然后你开始在流程中开发防错机制，

sentences.en: that if any of the weave or the weft breaks, the machine stops.
sentences.zh: 如果经线或纬线断裂，机器就会停止。

sentences.en: Improve the machinery's function as time goes on.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，不断改进机械的功能。

sentences.en: Add speed and velocity.
sentences.zh: 增加速度和效率。

sentences.en: I see that at Virginia Mason, we've just gotten off the floor, sitting on the chair.
sentences.zh: 我在弗吉尼亚梅森看到了这一点，我们刚刚从地板上站起来，坐在椅子上。

sentences.en: We've got a couple of mistake-proofing things in the yarn,
sentences.zh: 我们在毛线流程中加入了一些防错措施，

sentences.en: and someday we might be an automatic loom, but that might be 30, 40 years from now.
sentences.zh: 也许有一天我们会成为一台自动织布机，但这可能是30、40年后的事了。

sentences.en: But we've got a long way to go to mistake-proof health care, do it in a cost-efficient manner.
sentences.zh: 但我们在医疗防错和以成本效益方式进行医疗方面还有很长的路要走。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible was produced this week by David Weinberg, with help from me, Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 本周的《99%隐形》由戴维·温伯格制作，并得到了我，罗曼·马尔斯的帮助。

sentences.en: It was made possible with support from Lunar, making a difference with creativity.
sentences.zh: 它的实现离不开Lunar的支持，他们用创造力创造了改变。

sentences.en: It's a project of KALW 91.7 Local Public Radio in San Francisco,
